annotations.title: Report how a call to an MCP server went (7Maps)

description: Use this after calling a tool on an MCP server (especially one 7Maps pointed you to) to report how it went: whether it worked, why not, how long it took, whether the result matched the description, and anything it did that you did not ask for. Fixed fields only, no open text. Reports from many agents become the server's rating and, once 7Maps confirms them with its own check, live incident alerts that every agent sees. You can also pass the same fields as last_trip on your next call of any 7Maps tool. No charge.

agent_model.description: Optional: your model id, e.g. "claude-sonnet-5-5". Anonymous

ok.description: Did it do what you needed

surprise.description: Side effect you did not ask for

task_type.description: Optional: kind of work (only the category is kept)
